probe.title: Our Roots • Flashlights
probe.text_sample: Our Roots • Flashlights Our Roots • Flashlights Our Roots • Flashlights Read full article See the latest publications ethics of care Welcome. Get to know jailhouse lawyers and their loved ones through the words, wisdom, and experiences of incarcerated individuals who teach themselves the law to advocate for themselves and the rights of their peers. Please take care as you interact with these stories as they provide insight into alternatives and solutions to mass incarceration, but also touch upon difficult content, including confinement, medical neglect, and death, and retaliation that jailhouse lawyers routinely experience– from solitary confinement to transfers and restrictions on accessing law libraries and resources – simply because they seek to know, use, and shape law. Additionally, please approach this website with respect, care, responsibility, including without an intent of exploitation.
